action.description: A declared actor or object performing one concrete activity at the selected instant.
action.description_ko: 소유자가 특정 시점에 수행하는 동작: 시선·연속 절차·정지 자세가 섞임; 과정 단계와 순간 동작 구별
excludes: 시선·연속 절차·정지 자세가 섞임; 과정 단계와 순간 동작 구별
includes: A declared actor or object performing one concrete activity at the selected instant.

adult_presentation_context.description: Explicitly selected adult presentation context; adulthood alone is not sexual styling.
adult_presentation_context.description_ko: 명시적으로 선택된 성인 표현 맥락: 성인 연령 조건과 분리; 성인 등장 자체는 성적 표현 근거가 아님
excludes: 성인 연령 조건과 분리; 성인 등장 자체는 성적 표현 근거가 아님
includes: Explicitly selected adult presentation context; adulthood alone is not sexual styling.

aesthetic_trend.description: Visual aesthetic movement or stylistic practice, distinct from an entire plot, institution or world system.
aesthetic_trend.description_ko: 미적·시각적 표현 경향과 관습: 수사 절차·범죄 시스템·설화 전승은 genre·world·narrative_core와 재분류
excludes: 수사 절차·범죄 시스템·설화 전승은 genre·world·narrative_core와 재분류
A named day phase or lighting treatment alone does not establish a visual aesthetic movement or stylistic practice.
includes: Visual aesthetic movement or stylistic practice, distinct from an entire plot, institution or world system.

aftermath_trace.description: Owned physical residue of an explicitly declared prior event, distinct from an arbitrary surface state or ongoing process.
aftermath_trace.description_ko: 명시된 사건 뒤 남은 물리 흔적: 진행 중 서리·색 탈색·준비 상태가 섞임; 사건 결과인지 일반 표면 상태인지 구별
excludes: 진행 중 서리·색 탈색·준비 상태가 섞임; 사건 결과인지 일반 표면 상태인지 구별
includes: Owned physical residue of an explicitly declared prior event, distinct from an arbitrary surface state or ongoing process.

age_presentation.description: Explicitly declared age range or visible age presentation of an identified carrier or its explicitly owned local region; local appearance does not establish whole-owner chronological age, and intrinsic adult restrictions remain unchanged.
age_presentation.description_ko: 대상 또는 실제로 소유된 국소 영역의 명시된 연령 범위·보이는 연령 표현. 국소적인 나이 들어 보임·젊어 보임을 주체 전체의 실제 연령으로 확대하지 않으며, 기존 성인 제한은 그대로 누적한다.
excludes: Generic matte/glossy/rough texture, synthetic-skin material, wrinkles or a skin-region name alone without explicitly declared age presentation.
Chronological age, birth/manufacture history, adulthood, species, identity, health or family inferred from local skin or a provenance label.
Aged finish on non-skin material, weathering or damage alone is not subject/region visible age presentation merely because the adjective old/aged appears.

Part ownership is not equivalence: local region age appearance cannot be moved to the whole owner or another region. Distinct actual regions can legitimately have contrasting values on the same whole owner.

Selected age appearance remains E; explicit existing declared-age prerequisites retain P and cannot be used as permission to mutate locked age. Adult/human/domain source guards are neither inferred nor removed.
includes: Keep explicitly declared whole-carrier age range and visible age presentation, without inferring real chronological age from appearance.

An explicitly aged-looking versus young-looking owned skin-region contrast is local visible age presentation. Retain each actual region and owner; no new person, baby, exact age, family relation or global aged/young assignment follows.
A represented or synthetic carrier only receives the visible age presentation actually stated for its own region; representation identity alone is not a living age fact.

When one selection explicitly expresses both local skin microtexture and age appearance, appearance and age are two permission projections of that same semantic selection. Author both footprints consistently under the current proof contract; this is not an instruction for engine inference, automatic duplication or removal of locks.

air_humidity.description: Explicit moisture content or humidity state of an identified body or zone of air, indoors or outdoors, independent of visibility, suspended droplets, surface wetness, temperature and weather.
air_humidity.description_ko: 실내외 실제 공기 또는 공기 구역에 직접 선언된 습도·공기 수분 상태. 가시성·안개 입자·젖은 표면·온도·날씨를 별도로 구별한다.
excludes: Humid mood, tactile suggestion or a humidity variable name without an actual declared state/value/change.
Fog, steam, haze, visible airborne droplets or attenuation alone does not establish an air-humidity state; humidity alone does not require visible fog, droplets or lowered visibility.

Wet/damp/dry surfaces, sweat, condensation or a moisture-bearing material alone does not establish surrounding air humidity; explicit air humidity alone does not authorize surface wetness or condensation.
Temperature, weather, immersion, cultivation or a room label alone does not establish humidity. Do not infer a weather cause, humidifier, water source, chemical identity, thermal state or process.
Do not replace the actual air/zone carrier with every room surface, the whole world or an arbitrary foreground/main owner.
includes: Explicit humid, dry or otherwise stated air-humidity state on the actual selected air/zone carrier, including a growing room or an outdoor air zone.
Preserve a stated humidity number, unit, relative/absolute qualifier and zone literally when supplied; do not invent a value, measurement, calibration, equilibrium or conversion.

Choose selected effect, independently required prerequisite or preservation from the whole source; room/air nouns do not determine mode. Keep actual source/binding guards and independently qualified owner/receiver locks.

ambient_particle.description: Individually distinguishable airborne particles or droplets and their spatial distribution, separate from an unresolved haze or fog optical field.
ambient_particle.description_ko: 공기 중에서 개별 형상·점·궤적으로 구별되는 입자·물방울과 그 분포. 물리적으로 미립자를 포함하더라도 개별 입자 없이 연속 감쇠장으로만 표현된 안개·연무는 atmospheric_medium이며, 수중 입자·영상 입자·표면 방울과 구별한다.
excludes: An unresolved haze or fog field described only through spatial attenuation or contrast loss.
Underwater particles or bubbles, image-plane grain and droplets attached to a surface.
A living airborne animal needs its own declared subject/participant evidence; the particle slot does not add one.
includes: Individually distinguishable airborne particles or droplets and their spatial distribution, separate from an unresolved haze or fog optical field.

anatomical_connection.description: Ownership and continuity, articulation, attachment or explicitly intended separation of anatomical parts of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation; non-anatomical artifact joins remain separate.
anatomical_connection.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 해부학적 부위 소유·연속·관절·부착 또는 명시적으로 의도된 분리이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 꽃·잎·자기 줄기 연결도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 형태·비율·단순 접촉·비해부학적 공예물 접합과 구별하며 생존·성장·종을 추정하지 않는다.
evidence_terms: bloom attached to its own stem
excludes: Anatomical contour, regional volume, relative proportion or part names alone without an actual ownership, continuity, articulation, attachment or intended-separation proposition.
Touching, nearness, overlap or visual alignment of separately owned subjects/objects alone; contact does not merge anatomy or establish a shared biological owner.

Object hinges, hardware branches, textile/lace/paper flower assemblies and floral graphic-path joins alone. Depicted anatomical connection requires an explicitly declared anatomical depiction and remains scoped there, never inferred live continuity.

Continuity/attachment does not prove that an owner is alive, growing, functional, healthy, a particular species or made by a particular process; a cut or depicted botanical part does not gain a hidden whole plant.

An artifact or picture cannot alter/add a living actor or plant merely because its design resembles a biological part. Actor/plant/representation owner labels, source effects and optional members/profiles are not independent anatomical evidence.
includes: Ownership and continuity, articulation or explicitly intended separation of declared human or other animal anatomical parts, retaining each actual owner and endpoint.

The declared botanical bloom remaining attached to its own woody stem; separate blossoms attaching along the same continuous branch; leaves belonging to that same declared plant/branch. Source-stated absence or separation is retained without inventing extra organs.

Explicit anatomical attachment/continuity within a declared representation remains on the represented anatomy. A flat ornament path or assembled craft junction alone does not establish an anatomical relation.

Where a fabric rosette and a separate existing biological flower coexist, their distinct owners remain distinct: the flower own petal/stem relation cannot be donated to the garment, and cloth attachment cannot be recast as plant growth.

apparatus_pov.description: View through an identified aperture, optical apparatus or observation surface.
apparatus_pov.description_ko: 물리 구멍·광학 장치·관찰 매체를 통한 시야: 열영상·스캐너는 취득 방식도 관련; 카메라 종류·프레임 모양과 독립 근거 필요
excludes: 열영상·스캐너는 취득 방식도 관련; 카메라 종류·프레임 모양과 독립 근거 필요
includes: View through an identified aperture, optical apparatus or observation surface.

atmospheric_medium.description: Continuous or unresolved air, haze or fog and its spatial optical response, separate from individually distinguishable airborne particles, camera-path artifacts and emotional atmosphere.
atmospheric_medium.description_ko: 공기·안개·연무가 연속 또는 비분해 광학장으로 만드는 공간 감쇠·대비·가시성 상태. 안개의 물리적 미립자 유무를 사진으로 판정하지 않으며, 개별 공기 입자·물방울 형상은 ambient_particle, 촬영 광학 경로의 베일은 lens_artifact, 정서는 mood로 구별한다.
excludes: Individually distinguishable airborne particle or droplet units alone.
Camera-path veiling flare, image-plane grain or encoding damage.
Emotional mood, an inferred weather cause, or unobserved chemical composition.
An explicitly humid or dry air state without a stated spatial optical response belongs to air_humidity. Air humidity alone establishes neither fog, attenuation, visible droplets nor wet surfaces.
includes: Continuous or unresolved air, haze or fog and its spatial optical response, separate from individually distinguishable airborne particles, camera-path artifacts and emotional atmosphere.

attire_context.description: Declared role, culture, era or ceremony informing attire, separate from general garment construction.
attire_context.description_ko: 역할·문화·시대·의례를 명시한 복식 맥락: 일반 의복 구성과 분리; 전통 복식을 코스프레와 동일시하지 않음
excludes: 일반 의복 구성과 분리; 전통 복식을 코스프레와 동일시하지 않음
includes: Declared role, culture, era or ceremony informing attire, separate from general garment construction.

background_element.description: Declared secondary entities and structures in the background, separate from primary subjects and whole-place state.
background_element.description_ko: 배경 요소: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Declared secondary entities and structures in the background, separate from primary subjects and whole-place state.

body_form.description: Owned non-facial anatomical contour, regional volume or visible muscle and tendon form of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation. Independent of connection topology, relative proportions, pose, garment fit and non-anatomical artifact construction.
body_form.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 얼굴 이외 해부학적 윤곽·국소 부피·근육·힘줄 형태이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 기관 형태도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 연결 구조·상대 비율·자세·의복 부피·비해부학적 물건 구조와 구별하며 생존 상태·종·건강·능력·정체성을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: Body/plant region names, biological class words or connection topology alone without an independently stated anatomical contour or regional form.
Relative proportions, pose, facial geometry, garment fit or non-anatomical object/garment construction alone.

Floral graphic paths, repeating vegetal ornament, branch-shaped hardware or fabric/paper/lace flower parts do not become biological anatomy from resemblance or petal/stem labels. An explicitly declared anatomical depiction may describe represented organs only; its physical carrier remains an artifact.
A represented or artificial anatomical form does not alter or add a living actor/plant, and does not establish that its carrier is alive or that any depicted species exists physically.
Body weight, health, strength, biological age, origin, species, growth capacity, material chemistry or fabrication inferred from form.
Source owner, positive form and actual application scope must be explicit; metadata, source effects, an optional member/profile or an actor/plant/representation role word alone is not a form fact.
includes: Restrained visible muscle planes on a declared human or other animal; a localized neck vein contour or gluteal-thigh surface fold.

Large distinct floral segments forming an open cup on the declared botanical bloom; broad bounded leaf form or layered flower-organ form on its own declared plant owner. Plant form is not a claim of physiological life, growth capacity or species identification.

Explicitly depicted biological anatomy, including represented botanical organ form, stays on its declared representation. The source must actually describe anatomical form, not merely a floral style, motif or generic craft part.

A biological flower and a fabric rosette may occur in the same record, but anatomical form is assessed only on the declared biological flower or explicit anatomical depiction; cloth-fold form remains on the garment/craft owner.

body_hair.description: Owned regional body-hair density, length, distribution, skin attachment, individual-fiber thickness and pigmentation, separate from skin finish, scalp hair, facial hair and eyebrow or lash styling.
body_hair.description_ko: 지정 피부 부위에 소유된 체모의 밀도·길이·분포·피부 부착·개별 털 굵기·색소. 피부 마감·두발·수염·눈썹 및 속눈썹 연출과 구별하며, 선택한 속성만 적용한다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
Scalp-hair arrangement/color, facial-hair styling, brow/lash styling, skin pigment or skin optical finish alone.
Thickness or pigmentation does not prove age, sex, hormones, health, numerical composition or history.
includes: Owned regional body-hair density, length, distribution, skin attachment, individual-fiber thickness and pigmentation, separate from skin finish, scalp hair, facial hair and eyebrow or lash styling.

body_marking.description: Bounded natural, declared or applied markings on the owned body surface of an explicitly declared human or nonhuman actor, including a selected creature or machine-body design; owner and surface boundaries remain explicit.
body_marking.description_ko: 명시된 인간 또는 비인간 주체의 몸 표면에 한정된 국소 표식과 색 경계. 선택된 생물·기계 몸 디자인도 포함하되 기존 소유자·매체를 유지하고 인간 참조를 비인간으로 변환하지 않는다.
excludes: 화장·자연 표식·흉터 원인은 맥락 필요; 의복 무늬와 소유자 구별
A separate garment, bracelet, projected/cast shadow, emitted light or standalone object pattern cannot substitute for a body-surface mark.
A marking alone does not establish biological species, origin, injury/disease history or actual light emission.
Catalog permission never changes a candidate nonhuman-only guard or authorizes conversion of a referenced human.
includes: Bounded natural, declared or applied markings on the owned body surface of an explicitly declared human or nonhuman actor, including a selected creature or machine-body design; owner and surface boundaries remain explicit.

body_orientation.description: Explicit orientation of an identified body or relative rotation of its declared connected regions, including biological, mechanical and represented bodies.
body_orientation.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸과 명시적으로 연결된 부위의 축 방향·상대 회전. 카메라 방향·전신 지지 자세·눈의 시선과 구별한다.
excludes: Camera position, body support pose, eye-gaze direction and a scene object facing the frame are not interchangeable.
Standing or an activity alone does not supply a rotation, connected region, angle, axis or reference basis.
Do not infer eyes, a nose, joints or a human torso from the role name or a mechanical subject.
includes: A declared body axis orientation or relative rotation of connected regions, with the actual regions, relation and reference basis stated.
A nonhuman or represented body can qualify on the same literal contract. Actual source conditions and available owner regions still apply.

body_pose.description: Explicit whole-body posture or support, or explicitly stated local non-hand articulation of an identified biological, mechanical or represented body. Preserve the declared local part and its existing body ownership without inferring unmentioned anatomy.
body_pose.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸의 명시적 전신 자세·지지, 또는 직접 선언된 손 이외 국소 부위의 관절 자세. 실제 국소 부위와 기존 몸의 소유 관계를 보존하며 언급하지 않은 해부 부위나 지지 접촉을 추론하지 않는다.
excludes: A rigid object shape, a camera viewpoint or an activity word alone does not establish a whole-body pose.
Relative rotation of body axes, hand articulation, concrete action and rendered motion have separate roles when supported.
Do not turn an unavailable body or limb into a new entity to satisfy a pose.

Hand/finger articulation keeps hand_pose; explicit axis orientation or relative regional rotation keeps body_orientation. A local pose does not receive duplicate roles solely by renaming the same flexion as a rotation. A joint/hinge label, static object construction or generic believable movement alone does not supply a selected local articulated posture.
includes: Explicit standing, sitting, lying or other whole-body posture of a declared human, animal, robot or represented body.
Preserve the actual support and articulated connections when declared. Standing alone does not supply feet, legs, a supporting ground contact or a human body.
Decide effect versus a required existing posture from the whole source; source-specific category and domain conditions remain cumulative.

An explicitly bent elbow is a local articulated posture of that same owned elbow; it does not supply a full-body stance, an exact flexion angle, upper-arm/forearm inventory, a second actor or actual bending motion.

body_region.description: Named anatomical region or selected body part, distinct from the obligation to prove its visibility.
body_region.description_ko: 선택된 신체 부위와 관찰 범위: 부위 자체와 이를 보여야 하는 검증 의무를 분리; framing·해부 연결과 연계
excludes: 부위 자체와 이를 보여야 하는 검증 의무를 분리; framing·해부 연결과 연계
includes: Named anatomical region or selected body part, distinct from the obligation to prove its visibility.

brow_style.description: Owned eyebrow-hair shape, strand arrangement, grooming or cosmetic line, separate from expression-related elevation, lowering or convergence of the brow relative to facial landmarks.
brow_style.description_ko: 눈썹 털의 형태·결·정리 또는 화장 선. 얼굴 기준점에 대한 눈썹의 상승·하강·미간 수축 같은 표정 위치와 구별한다.
excludes: 자연 털과 화장 선은 적용 맥락으로 구별; 눈썹을 눈 화장 전체로 확대하지 않음
Expression-related brow elevation, lowering or convergence alone belongs to expression; it does not establish grooming, a cosmetic line or a private emotion.
includes: Owned eyebrow-hair shape, strand arrangement, grooming or cosmetic line, separate from expression-related elevation, lowering or convergence of the brow relative to facial landmarks.

calendar_context.description: Explicit day type or calendar interval such as weekday, weekend or eve, distinct from clock time and named occasion.
calendar_context.description_ko: 달력 시점: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Explicit day type or calendar interval such as weekday, weekend or eve, distinct from clock time and named occasion.

camera_direction.description: Camera viewing axis and roll relative to the subject, distinct from height, distance and body orientation.
camera_direction.description_ko: 카메라 관측 방향과 대상 대비 각도: 높이·관찰 위치·몸 방향이 섞임; 관측축과 위치를 별도 표현
excludes: 높이·관찰 위치·몸 방향이 섞임; 관측축과 위치를 별도 표현
includes: Camera viewing axis and roll relative to the subject, distinct from height, distance and body orientation.

camera_distance.description: Physical camera-to-subject distance or declared observer separation, independent of shot scale and lens choice.
camera_distance.description_ko: 카메라 거리: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Physical camera-to-subject distance or declared observer separation, independent of shot scale and lens choice.

camera_height.description: Camera height relative to a declared reference, distinct from viewing axis and distance.
camera_height.description_ko: 지정 기준면·대상 대비 카메라 높이: 카메라 기울기·관찰자 사회적 역할과 구별; 높이만으로 광학을 확정하지 않음
excludes: 카메라 기울기·관찰자 사회적 역할과 구별; 높이만으로 광학을 확정하지 않음
includes: Camera height relative to a declared reference, distinct from viewing axis and distance.

camera_movement.description: Declared camera movement or support stability during capture, separate from subject movement and its recorded blur.

includes: Current distribution, transfer or loss of an owned cosmetic layer, without inferring elapsed time or cause.

material_form.description: Explicit macroscopic contour, bounded volume shape or coherent spatial form of an identified non-anatomical fluid, deformable material mass or transient material body, independent of constructed-object structure and illumination geometry.
material_form.description_ko: 명시된 비해부학적 유체·변형 가능한 물질 덩어리·일시적 물질체 자체의 거시적 윤곽·부피 형상·응집된 공간 형태. 공예·물건의 구조와 빛의 투사·광선 형상에서 분리한다.
excludes: Geometry or part assembly of a separately identified discrete object, vessel, fixture or constructed item belongs to object_structure; garment construction and anatomy retain their specialized roles. A material-body contour is not a container or emitter-housing contour. Softness alone does not turn a constructed object or textile panel into a free material mass. Preserve the actual declared carrier and do not duplicate the same contour by renaming it object or matter.

Receiving-surface illumination, volumetric rays, highlights and shadow boundaries are light_shape, not the contour of a luminous material body. A teardrop-shaped flame does not establish a teardrop projection on a surface.
Material identity, chemistry, temperature, phase transition, emission mechanism, motion, texture, optical sheen or moisture alone without a positive macroscopic shape proposition.
Airborne particle units/distribution, unresolved haze/attenuation and liquid inclusions alone are owned by their respective roles; an additional explicit material-body contour requires its own fact.
A drawn/printed flame or teardrop motif, a rigid teardrop lamp housing or an image artifact is not an actual flame/fluid body from resemblance.
Do not infer combustion mechanism, fuel, heat, a droplet, exact dimensions, permanence, a newly introduced body or an actual ritual from a shape adjective.
includes: A positively described teardrop contour of the flame body itself; its luminous source type and key-light use are separate facts.

An explicitly shaped fluid ribbon, coherent liquid blob or deformable material mass, with its actual body/region and physical extent identified. These are normative boundary examples, not newly corpus-reviewed candidates.
A selected form is an appearance effect; a separately required existing form or expressly preserved form retains its actual mode. No new material body follows from the slot name.

material_mechanics.description: Explicitly declared softness, hardness, rigidity, stiffness, flexibility, deformability or elastic response of one identified material, object material region or material layer, distinct from its identity, optical finish, static geometry and actual motion.
material_mechanics.description_ko: 소유자가 특정된 물질·물건의 재료 영역·재료층에 직접 선언된 부드러움·경도·강성·뻣뻣함·유연성·변형성·탄성 반응. 재질 정체·광학 마감·정적 형상·실제 움직임과 구별하며, 외관만으로 물성을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: Material names, glossy appearance, crinkling, folds, roundness, a spring/hinge label or a soft visual mood alone without an explicit mechanical-quality proposition.
Actual motion, a selected transformation stage, part assembly, static layer thickness or object width/height alone; no duplicate role on the same property merely by renaming its carrier.

Soft anatomical contour, temporal fullness, expression, emotional softness or light softness alone is not constitutive material softness. An independently declared biological or represented carrier is not inferred from the role.

Do not infer chemistry, modulus, force, numeric hardness, safety, durability, load capacity, a pressure source, pneumatic operation or measured success. Preserve any explicitly stated real value or condition rather than deleting it for lack of measurement certification.
No mass, density, lightweight claim, temperature or moisture is established by softness, rigidity or flexibility. No new layer, object, body part or actor follows from this slot.
includes: An explicitly rigid toe-ring object retains that same ring as carrier; its circular outline and worn placement are separate facts.

Explicit soft polymer and flexible pneumatic channels retain their separately declared actual material/channel owners. Deforming edges are actual motion, not proof that every material region is flexible.

A declared mechanical quality is a source requirement, not a certified measurement. A selected quality is an effect; a separately required existing quality is a prerequisite; an express preservation keeps the exact independently frozen quality.

material_thickness.description: Explicit physical thickness or thinness of one identified material layer or its bounded cross-section, separate from in-plane width, whole-object outline, optical opacity and material identity.
material_thickness.description_ko: 소유자가 특정된 재료층 또는 그 경계 단면의 직접 선언된 물리적 두께·얇음. 면 안의 폭·전체 물체 윤곽·광학 불투명도·재질 정체와 구별하고, 층이나 단면을 새로 만들지 않는다.
excludes: Broad/substantial width, long length, large garment volume, a chunky style name or visible edge alone without actual thickness meaning. Ambiguous chunky-band wording must not silently select a cross-sectional axis.
Optical opacity/transmission, pigment concentration, thin cosmetic coverage, a thin light band, anatomical slenderness or low visual density alone.
Material softness, stiffness, mass, lightweight status, strength, insulation or chemistry inferred from thickness.

Physical assembly or whole-object geometry already fully expressed by a specialized construction role does not receive a second thickness fact by renaming that same geometry. Separate positive material-layer thickness can coexist with distinct construction, texture or optical facts.
Do not invent a separate backing layer, new material body, exact dimension, wearer, body part or product from the role name.
includes: An explicitly thin fabric layer in loose trousers retains the material-layer owner; crinkling, garment openings and loose fit have separate meanings.
A declared plastic layer with bounded thick edges supports its material cross-section thickness. Its transparency, reflections, flexibility and the edge outline remain separately evaluated.

Mode follows the complete source: selected thickness is an effect; required existing thickness is a prerequisite; explicitly maintained thickness is preservation. Preserve a stated number/unit literally without inventing one.

medium.description: Physical photographic acquisition or display medium and the image-bearing substrate.
medium.description_ko: 사진의 물리 매체와 이미지 지지체: 여행·패션은 genre; 셀피·CCTV는 촬영 구성; 플랫폼 용도와 분리
excludes: 여행·패션은 genre; 셀피·CCTV는 촬영 구성; 플랫폼 용도와 분리
includes: Physical photographic acquisition or display medium and the image-bearing substrate.

mood.description: Emotional atmosphere or proposed affective reading of the scene, not a measured state of air or a proven private emotion.
mood.description_ko: 장면이 제안하는 정서와 분위기 해석: 공기 중 안개·먼지와 구별; 인물의 실제 마음을 확인했다고 주장하지 않음
excludes: 공기 중 안개·먼지와 구별; 인물의 실제 마음을 확인했다고 주장하지 않음
includes: Emotional atmosphere or proposed affective reading of the scene, not a measured state of air or a proven private emotion.

motion_rendering.description: Image-plane freezing, streaks or blur from declared motion and capture, separate from physical action itself.
motion_rendering.description_ko: 영상에 기록된 움직임: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Image-plane freezing, streaks or blur from declared motion and capture, separate from physical action itself.

nail_appearance.description: Visible shape, length, color, finish or decoration of an owned fingernail or toenail plate, separate from skin marks and joint pose.
nail_appearance.description_ko: 소유자가 명시된 손톱·발톱 판의 보이는 모양·길이·색·마감·장식. 피부의 문양·손 관절 자세·손가락 길이와 구별하며 건강이나 정체성을 진단하지 않는다.
excludes: Skin pigment or a tattoo on a finger.
Hand pose or finger proportions.
Clinical diagnosis, ancestry or age inferred from nails.
includes: Light free-edge band distinct from a nail's base color.
Named nail plate shape, length or finish.

narrative_clue.description: An owned visible clue supporting a declared event interpretation, with observation and inferred chronology kept separate.
narrative_clue.description_ko: 서사 해석의 단서: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: An owned visible clue supporting a declared event interpretation, with observation and inferred chronology kept separate.

narrative_core.description: Central event, problem or relationship organizing the scene, distinct from a world system or a title alone.
narrative_core.description_ko: 장면을 조직하는 중심 사건·관계·문제: secret garden 같은 제목과 world 전체 체계가 섞임; 단일 사건의 의미 근거 필요
excludes: secret garden 같은 제목과 world 전체 체계가 섞임; 단일 사건의 의미 근거 필요
includes: Central event, problem or relationship organizing the scene, distinct from a world system or a title alone.

narrative_phase.description: Selected instant or phase within an explicitly declared human, natural, mechanical or other event, distinct from clock time, a named occasion and inferred chronology.
narrative_phase.description_ko: 명시된 인간·자연·기계 등 사건 안에서 선택한 순간이나 단계. 하루 시각·행사 명목과 구별하며 사건의 원인·완료·연속 경과를 추론하지 않는다.
excludes: Clock time, season, historical era and the name of an occasion alone.
An inferred preceding cause, unmentioned event, completed outcome or elapsed sequence.
Do not infer rainfall from wetness or a clock time from low tide; a phase requires its explicit source event relation.
includes: Explicit before/after/during relations and selected natural-event phases, including an already declared loading event, rainfall or tide.
Human participation is not required. Existing source conditions and actual event/carrier identity remain mandatory.
A procedure operation or material transformation can additionally have its own role; a selected event phase alone does not supply the operation or transformation.

object_structure.description: Visible non-anatomical geometry, bounded parts and structural connections owned by one declared physical object or fixture, independent of its scene role, frame placement and current use state.
object_structure.description_ko: 선언된 물리적 물체·설비 자체의 비해부학적 형상, 경계가 있는 부품과 구조적 연결. 장면에서 맡는 용도·프레임 배치·현재 사용 상태와 구별하며, 몸·의복 특화 구조의 소유 범위를 보존한다.
excludes: Anatomical form, pose or continuity, including depicted anatomy whose representation ownership must remain explicit.
Frame arrangement, camera viewpoint, relative prop placement or image acuity alone.
Current open/closed, use, damage or readiness state without a separately evidenced structural feature.
Material identity or repeated surface microstructure alone; abstract two-dimensional graphic-path geometry alone.

A garment-specific construction fact already fully owned by garment_detail does not receive a duplicate generic role for that same fact. Simultaneous roles require separately evidenced properties or distinct owned components.
An optional garment member/profile cannot supply unconditional garment ownership or garment type to a generic parent.

Macroscopic form of a free fluid, coherent material mass or transient material body is material_form when that material body is the actual declared carrier. A separately identified vessel, fixture, discrete object or constructed item keeps its own object_structure scope. Do not duplicate the same contour merely by renaming its carrier object or matter.
includes: A declared case hinge and separately bounded disc recess; phone halves joined at their hinge.
A named strap assembly with a bar and incoming/returning strap path; a generic attached textile panel with its own bounded edge.
An identified fixture part and its structural joint; no claim of hidden manufacture or performance.

occasion_context.description: Explicit occasion, ceremony or scheduled event shaping the scene, distinct from any arbitrary process step.
occasion_context.description_ko: 명시된 행사·의례·계기·일정이 장면에 부여하는 맥락. 일반 준비·검토·작업의 진행 단계 자체를 행사나 계기로 확대하지 않으며, 행사 맥락과 과정 시점은 별도로 판정한다.
excludes: An arbitrary preparation, review or work-process stage alone does not establish an occasion, ceremony or scheduled event. A genuinely declared event may coexist with its separately stated process or narrative phase.
Do not infer an event, real ceremony, participant role or completed occurrence from a ritual-like style, location, object, generic activity or provenance label alone.
includes: Explicit occasion, ceremony or scheduled event shaping the scene, distinct from any arbitrary process step.

offscreen_context.description: Explicitly declared off-frame participants, events or space and their visible relation, not automatically added actors.
offscreen_context.description_ko: 화면 밖 맥락: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Explicitly declared off-frame participants, events or space and their visible relation, not automatically added actors.

participant_role.description: Explicit participation or relational role of a declared participant, whether primary or secondary, without inferring identity, occupation or a new counterpart from appearance.
participant_role.description_ko: 주·보조 구분 없이 이미 명시된 참여자의 참여상·관계상 역할. 외모에서 정체·직업·관계를 추론하거나 역할 이름만으로 상대역을 추가하지 않는다.
excludes: Off-frame placement, a back view and person count belong to their independently supported framing/count roles.
A rival/partner label does not itself create another participant or establish actual identity, occupation, disposition or a performed interaction.
Role truth and tag fit remain separate from effect permission; a prerequisite role cannot authorize a new role or relationship.
includes: A declared participant role can belong to either the primary or another existing participant. The source must identify the actual role carrier and any independently required relation endpoints.

physical_mass.description: Explicit physical mass or ordinary physical heaviness/lightness declared for one identified carrier or an explicitly owned part, including a stated comparison or literal numeric mass/weight value. Keep physical quantity, owner scope and source claim status distinct from appearance and measured verification.
physical_mass.description_ko: 하나의 실제 선언된 대상 또는 그 대상이 실제로 소유한 부위의 명시적 물리 질량·무게·가벼움·무거움. 명시된 비교와 질량·무게 수치도 포함하되, 물리량 종류·소유 범위·원문의 주장 수준을 보존하며 외관이나 측정 확인으로 확대하지 않는다.
excludes: Visual/compositional weight, metaphorical narrative weight, emotional heaviness, heavy rain intensity, hair weight-line geometry, or a density/size/style label alone without an actual physical mass/weight proposition.

Lightweight-looking, heavy-looking, airy appearance, dense-looking texture or an evoked heavy/light sensation alone. Preserve that exact appearance or sensory wording, but do not upgrade it to actual mass. Sensory_cue requires its own observable-proxy contract; it is not an automatic fallback tag.

Thickness, macroscopic volume, garment fit, body contour, packing density, material identity, optical finish, stiffness, flexibility or thermal state alone. None supplies mass by inference, and a broad material.* technical prefix does not expand surface_material prose.

Body-weight distribution, load-bearing support, a force, pressure, gravitational acceleration, buoyancy, inertia, drag or motion alone. Keep explicit support/contact/motion independently; do not derive a mass or strength from them.
An ungrounded comparison endpoint, an unspecified collective inventory, a new object or anatomical part introduced to carry the property, or transfer from local part to whole/body/neighbor.

Actual body weight, health, ability, age, identity or attractiveness inferred from anatomy, clothing size, posture, a material name, perspective, or visible handling effort. No new human, body-weight target or change is supplied by the slot.

A scale, display number, weighing verb or provenance label alone is not verified mass or a certified measurement. Visible text, a measuring operation and actual declared quantity each retain separate evidence/permission; no force-versus-mass conversion or fabricated number/unit.
Metadata tags, existing effects/old slot names, negative guards, optional children or source owner category labels cannot supply a positive mass value or mandatory whole-record role.
includes: An explicitly lightweight garment or material body, heavy ledger or heavy gate qualifies on its actual declared carrier even without a number, unit or visual weighing demonstration. Do not delete the qualitative meaning because measurement is unavailable.

A statement that one identified carrier or explicitly owned part is lighter/heavier than another preserves both independently grounded endpoints and its stated comparison basis. No absolute mass, size ratio or density follows.

A source-stated numeric mass/weight preserves the literal number, unit, referent, quantity kind and stated conditions. It is a declared value unless the source separately states a measurement claim; neither is independently verified by a visible scale or numeral alone. Do not convert mass to force or change units.
Keep a local part value on that exact part. It does not become the whole owner mass or another region mass, and a whole value does not distribute to parts without an explicit source rule.

A selected physical mass/heaviness/lightness remains E. A separately required existing declared mass/weight is P; an explicit preserve instruction is PR. Actual change in mass retains both carrier and stated change, without inventing material addition/removal, a cause, rate or endpoint. A role label or an existing-owner selection is never a waiver of the actual selected effect.

Intrinsic human/adult/domain guards, independent owner selection, permitted operation and actual locks remain mandatory. A literal declared body mass is not inferred from body form; this role neither creates a person nor authorizes a body-weight change.

physical_motion.description: Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.
physical_motion.description_ko: 물리 움직임 상태와 촬영된 움직임 표현: 정지·깜빡임·카메라 흔들림·영상 궤적이 섞임; owner와 image plane별 분리 여부 결정
excludes: 정지·깜빡임·카메라 흔들림·영상 궤적이 섞임; owner와 image plane별 분리 여부 결정
includes: Physical motion or rest of declared actors, objects and materials, separate from recorded streaks or shake.

platform_framing.description: Crop-safe and interface-safe placement for a declared output platform, separate from aspect ratio.
platform_framing.description_ko: 출력 매체의 크롭과 UI 안전 영역: 비율은 format; 일반 프레임 가장자리 크롭은 composition·subject_framing
excludes: 비율은 format; 일반 프레임 가장자리 크롭은 composition·subject_framing
includes: Crop-safe and interface-safe placement for a declared output platform, separate from aspect ratio.

presentation_style.description: Visible personal presentation and grooming, without inferring profession, personality or identity.
presentation_style.description_ko: 인물의 외적 연출과 차림 인상: 직업·성격·정체성이 아님; serene presence 등 정서와 복식이 섞임
excludes: 직업·성격·정체성이 아님; serene presence 등 정서와 복식이 섞임
includes: Visible personal presentation and grooming, without inferring profession, personality or identity.

procedure_step.description: One identified step in a declared procedure, not a claim that a sequence was observed in one still image.
procedure_step.description_ko: 명시된 작업 과정에서 선택한 단계: 여러 단계의 완료·시간 흐름을 한 픽셀 사실로 취급하지 않음
excludes: 여러 단계의 완료·시간 흐름을 한 픽셀 사실로 취급하지 않음
includes: One identified step in a declared procedure, not a claim that a sequence was observed in one still image.

prop.description: An explicitly owned scene object serving a declared role; placement and state are separate properties.
prop.description_ko: 장면 안에서 특정 역할을 갖는 물건: 주체·착용물·기록 장치와 소유 범위 구별; 빈 dimensions를 자동 통과로 바꾸지 않음
excludes: 주체·착용물·기록 장치와 소유 범위 구별; 빈 dimensions를 자동 통과로 바꾸지 않음
includes: An explicitly owned scene object serving a declared role; placement and state are separate properties.

prop_placement.description: Position and orientation of owned props relative to named actors, surfaces and boundaries.
prop_placement.description_ko: 소품의 방향·배치·주체와의 공간 관계: 막대 방향뿐 아니라 장벽·주머니·둘레가 섞임; 물건 상태는 prop_state
excludes: 막대 방향뿐 아니라 장벽·주머니·둘레가 섞임; 물건 상태는 prop_state
includes: Position and orientation of owned props relative to named actors, surfaces and boundaries.

prop_state.description: Owned object's current use, attachment, readiness, damage or arrangement state, with occupational context optional.
prop_state.description_ko: 물건의 사용·정리·고정·손상 상태: 업무 소품으로만 한정할 근거가 약함; duty는 맥락 조건으로 보존
excludes: 업무 소품으로만 한정할 근거가 약함; duty는 맥락 조건으로 보존
includes: Owned object's current use, attachment, readiness, damage or arrangement state, with occupational context optional.

proxemics.description: Explicit physical spacing or access-barrier relations between independently declared participants or a declared participant group, including human and nonhuman participants, without inferring intimacy, intent or count.
proxemics.description_ko: 독립적으로 선언된 참여자 또는 참여 집단의 실제 간격·접근 장벽 관계. 사람과 비인간 참여자 모두 포함하며, 간격에서 친밀감·의도·정확한 수·새 상대역을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: A participant/group name, count, co-presence or landing activity alone does not establish spacing.
Frame-plane arrangement/negative space alone belongs to composition; crowd occupancy/density is not interchangeable with a participant spacing relation.
Prop positions or a camera-to-subject distance alone do not establish participant spacing.
Spacing does not add a person, animal or relation endpoint, change participant count, prove migration behavior or supply social/psychological meaning.
Role eligibility is not mutation permission. An existing relation prerequisite cannot authorize moving endpoints or bypass receiver/property/count locks.
includes: Actual spacing between identified human or nonhuman participants, or an explicitly identified group whose internal spacing is positively stated.
Natural flock/group spacing is a qualitative physical relation when the positive source actually states it; no numeric gap, regular lattice, density or exact count follows.
An explicitly declared counter/threshold barrier can mediate spacing, but formal social reading, actual access entitlement and intent require independent positive meaning.
Retain actual owner, relation endpoints and selected group/member scope. Preserve all intrinsic source and independently frozen binding conditions conjunctively.

publication_caption_context.description: Context of an external publication caption and how it frames interpretation, not text inside the image.
publication_caption_context.description_ko: 게시 문구와 사진 해석의 맥락: 이미지 안의 글자와 분리; 현재 성인 SNS·외모 평가 문구 편향
excludes: 이미지 안의 글자와 분리; 현재 성인 SNS·외모 평가 문구 편향
includes: Context of an external publication caption and how it frames interpretation, not text inside the image.

reality_anchor.description: A declared ordinary reference whose relation makes a selected extraordinary concept legible.
reality_anchor.description_ko: 비현실 관계를 읽게 하는 현실 기준 대상: 평범한 컵·연기 자체는 prop; 특정 개념과의 비교 역할이 있을 때 연결
excludes: 평범한 컵·연기 자체는 prop; 특정 개념과의 비교 역할이 있을 때 연결
includes: A declared ordinary reference whose relation makes a selected extraordinary concept legible.

reflection_logic.description: Correspondence or intended discrepancy between an owned physical object and its reflected image.
reflection_logic.description_ko: 원 대상과 반사상 사이의 대응 관계: 그림자·발광은 다른 역할; 어긋난 반사는 의도된 비현실 범위 필요
excludes: 그림자·발광은 다른 역할; 어긋난 반사는 의도된 비현실 범위 필요
includes: Correspondence or intended discrepancy between an owned physical object and its reflected image.

relational_action.description: Concrete interaction with explicitly declared action endpoints, including biological, mechanical or represented participants and their objects.
relational_action.description_ko: 명시된 행위 주체와 상대·물체 사이의 구체적 상호 동작. 인간·동물·기계·묘사된 대상을 포함하며 실제 행위와 소유·접촉 관계를 구별한다.
excludes: A role label, co-presence, proximity or an isolated hand pose does not supply a performed interaction.
Do not add a counterpart, helper, contact, tool or action endpoint from a verb category alone.
Do not split one actual self-owned body into two people or merge explicitly distinct participants.
includes: The source explicitly describes the participants or a participant and an object interacting; each endpoint must be independently supported.
Self-directed interaction can address an explicitly owned part or object while retaining its actual part/whole relationship.
A human participant is not compulsory. Intrinsic source conditions, distinctness or part ownership, and actual performed action remain mandatory.

scale_relation.description: Comparative size relation between explicitly identified entities with a stated depth or perspective basis.
scale_relation.description_ko: 둘 이상의 명시된 대상 간 크기 관계: 절대 크기·원근 왜곡과 구별; 비교 기준과 깊이 관계를 보존
excludes: 절대 크기·원근 왜곡과 구별; 비교 기준과 깊이 관계를 보존
includes: Comparative size relation between explicitly identified entities with a stated depth or perspective basis.

season.description: Explicit seasonal setting or its declared observable cues, not a season inferred from one ambiguous object.
season.description_ko: 계절: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Explicit seasonal setting or its declared observable cues, not a season inferred from one ambiguous object.

sensory_cue.description: Observable proxy for a proposed touch, heat, smell or sound interpretation, without claiming the sensation was measured.
sensory_cue.description_ko: 촉각·온도·소리·냄새를 연상시키는 관찰 단서: 수증기·진동·접촉을 실제 감각 확인과 구별; 단서와 서사 해석 연결
excludes: 수증기·진동·접촉을 실제 감각 확인과 구별; 단서와 서사 해석 연결
includes: Observable proxy for a proposed touch, heat, smell or sound interpretation, without claiming the sensation was measured.

shadow_relation.description: Declared caster, receiving surface and shadow correspondence, separate from reflection and light-level claims.
shadow_relation.description_ko: 그림자 대응 관계: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Declared caster, receiving surface and shadow correspondence, separate from reflection and light-level claims.

shot_scale.description: Extent of subject coverage relative to the photograph's field, without equating it to focal length or physical distance.
shot_scale.description_ko: 대상 대비 촬영 범위의 규모: 포함해야 할 부위의 목적은 subject_framing; 렌즈·거리를 범위만으로 확정하지 않음
excludes: 포함해야 할 부위의 목적은 subject_framing; 렌즈·거리를 범위만으로 확정하지 않음
includes: Extent of subject coverage relative to the photograph's field, without equating it to focal length or physical distance.

silhouette_proportion.description: Owned body or clothed silhouette proportions, with body and garment carriers explicitly distinguished.
silhouette_proportion.description_ko: 선택한 몸·차림 실루엣의 비례: 신체 비례와 레깅스 길이 같은 의복 범위가 섞임; owner별 속성 분리
excludes: 신체 비례와 레깅스 길이 같은 의복 범위가 섞임; owner별 속성 분리
includes: Owned body or clothed silhouette proportions, with body and garment carriers explicitly distinguished.

situation_context.description: Concrete local circumstances explaining the scene's event, distinct from genre, world rules and a named occasion.
situation_context.description_ko: 한 장면의 행동을 이해하는 구체 상황: 세계 전체 규칙·행사 명목·서사 중심과 구별; 만능 상황 태그 자동 부착 금지
excludes: 세계 전체 규칙·행사 명목·서사 중심과 구별; 만능 상황 태그 자동 부착 금지
includes: Concrete local circumstances explaining the scene's event, distinct from genre, world rules and a named occasion.

skin_condition.description: Current observable skin state, separate from durable markings, cosmetic layers and unproven diagnosis.
skin_condition.description_ko: 피부의 현재 국소 상태와 변화: 주근깨·영구 표식·화장과 구별; 원인·질환을 외관에서 확정하지 않음
excludes: 주근깨·영구 표식·화장과 구별; 원인·질환을 외관에서 확정하지 않음
includes: Current observable skin state, separate from durable markings, cosmetic layers and unproven diagnosis.

skin_finish.description: Explicit optical finish or microtexture of an identified owned skin surface or local skin region, including independently declared biological, synthetic or represented skin, separate from body hair, geometry, material identity and private health state.
skin_finish.description_ko: 독립적으로 명시된 실제 피부·합성 피부·묘사된 피부의 소유된 표면이나 국소 영역에 속한 광학 마감·미세 질감. 체모·형태·재질 정체·사적인 건강 상태와 구별하며, 역할 이름에서 살아 있는 피부나 사람을 만들지 않는다.
excludes: A skin, actor, robot, doll, material or surface label alone without a positively declared finish/microtexture. Generic presence or a role word does not supply skin.
Material identity alone, body hair, anatomical geometry, pigment/marking, cosmetic layer, wetness or a clinical state alone without the independently stated optical finish/microtexture.

Synthetic/represented skin does not become biological skin, add a living carrier or inherit another owner anatomy. A skin-like textile/paint/outer-shell metaphor needs exact source identity rather than a guessed anatomical conversion.
Microtexture alone does not prove actual age, family, disease, injury, health, cause, material chemistry or a specific wrinkle/pore pattern.
Ordinary roughness without explicit age presentation does not add age E. Conversely explicit selected aged/young presentation must not be deleted or relabeled P to evade age locks.
Do not duplicate the same optical/microtexture fact merely to obtain generic surface roles or new owners; separate material/texture properties need their own actual meaning.
includes: An actual owned skin surface or exact local skin region with positively stated optical finish or microtexture. Its biological, synthetic or represented identity must be independently supported; human-only scene classification is not required.
A matte synthetic skin surface with explicitly stated pores retains the artificial owner; no living actor, actual biological pores or real skin health is inferred.

Explicit aged-looking versus young-looking skin microtexture can support local skin finish and visible local age presentation from the same positive selection. They are shared semantic evidence, not two independent aging processes; both actual permission dimensions remain explicit when the whole source selects them.

A selected region keeps its exact actual owner and part/whole relations. Distinct regions may belong to the same or different actual owners; no automatic primary skin, two people or whole-owner transfer.

skin_tone.description: Owned skin color and local color variation under declared illumination and white balance, distinct from cosmetics and image grading; apparent color does not prove intrinsic pigment or identity.
skin_tone.description_ko: 같은 피부 부위의 색과 국소 색 변이. 조명·화이트밸런스 기준이 명시된 보이는 색도 포함하되, 그 색으로 고유 색소·민족·정체성을 역추정하지 않으며 화장·그레이딩과 구별한다.
excludes: Light color, cosmetic pigment, textile lining color or image grading alone.
Apparent skin color without its observation conditions cannot establish intrinsic pigment, ancestry or identity.
includes: Owned skin color or local variation.
Apparent color of a named skin region with capture illumination and white balance declared.

social_cue.description: Visible reactions, attention or allocation relations supporting a declared social reading.
social_cue.description_ko: 타인의 반응·자원 배치로 드러난 사회적 단서: 표정 하나와 집단 반응·접근 권한 변화를 구별; 사회적 해석은 사실 단정이 아님
excludes: 표정 하나와 집단 반응·접근 권한 변화를 구별; 사회적 해석은 사실 단정이 아님
includes: Visible reactions, attention or allocation relations supporting a declared social reading.

space_condition.description: Explicit current physical or use condition of an identified place and its declared zones, including exposure or inundation by a named medium, distinct from structural location, weather and event phase.
space_condition.description_ko: 선언된 장소와 구역 자체의 현재 물리·사용 상태. 특정 매질에 대한 노출·침수·잠김 구역을 포함하며, 장소 구조·날씨·사건 단계·표면 수분과 구별한다.
excludes: A place name, weather label or event-phase label alone does not establish physical exposure, flooding or immersion.
Surface wet/damp/dry condition is not the same as exposed/submerged coverage; exposure does not imply dryness and wetness does not prove immersion.
No inferred rainfall, weather, tide cause, water chemistry, depth, salinity, current, elapsed process, biological community or completed event from the state.
Local fixture wear/utilities/use traces are environment_detail; merely being an environmental surface does not make every physical state a wear/use trace.
Object immersion, garment wetness and camera crop/visibility alone are not a place-state fact. Additional object/surface/framing roles need separately supported carrier meaning.
A state on one zone cannot be generalized to all places/zones or used to add a missing zone/medium. Preservation clauses cannot be silently recast as a new mutable state.
includes: Retain existing use, preparation, maintenance and damage states of an actual place.
Natural or built-place physical state may specify which actual zones are exposed or submerged relative to the independently identified medium. Preserve all stated contrasting zones simultaneously.
A selected low-tide phase and the upper-exposed/lower-submerged place configuration have distinct timing and setting meaning. Neither substitutes for the other.

The actual place, every affected zone, medium and any independently required ownership/part relation must be explicit. Existing source and binding conditions are retained conjunctively; same owner/receiver locks still apply.

spatial_depth.description: Depth ordering, overlap and perspective relations among foreground, middle distance and background owners.
spatial_depth.description_ko: 장면의 깊이 구조: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Depth ordering, overlap and perspective relations among foreground, middle distance and background owners.

species_marker.description: Anatomical species cues owned by a declared subject, distinct from detachable costume ornaments.
species_marker.description_ko: 주체에 소유된 종별 신체 단서: 살아 있는 귀·꼬리와 착용 장식을 구별; 특정 변신 설정에만 한정하지 않음
excludes: 살아 있는 귀·꼬리와 착용 장식을 구별; 특정 변신 설정에만 한정하지 않음
includes: Anatomical species cues owned by a declared subject, distinct from detachable costume ornaments.

staging_degree.description: Declared posed, candid or directed presentation, without claiming unobserved camera awareness as fact.
staging_degree.description_ko: 촬영의 연출 정도: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Declared posed, candid or directed presentation, without claiming unobserved camera awareness as fact.

subject.description: The primary declared visible entity or entities that the photograph is about.
subject.description_ko: 장면의 주된 관찰 대상: 동반 대상은 별도 소유자; 이름만으로 인원·종을 추가하지 않음
excludes: 동반 대상은 별도 소유자; 이름만으로 인원·종을 추가하지 않음
includes: The primary declared visible entity or entities that the photograph is about.

subject_count.description: Explicit number and grouping of declared visible or required participants.
subject_count.description_ko: 주체 수: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Explicit number and grouping of declared visible or required participants.

subject_framing.description: Inclusion, crop and visibility of named subjects or body regions, with explicit owner and participant count.
subject_framing.description_ko: 지정 주체와 필요한 부위의 프레임 포함 범위: body_framing·partner_framing은 소유자·범위로 통합 검토; shot_scale과 목적 구별
excludes: body_framing·partner_framing은 소유자·범위로 통합 검토; shot_scale과 목적 구별
includes: Inclusion, crop and visibility of named subjects or body regions, with explicit owner and participant count.

surface_material.description: Declared surface material and observable optical response; chemical identity and performance require separate context.
surface_material.description_ko: 지정 표면의 재질과 광학 반응: 직조 조직은 texture도 가능; 화학 정체·온도·내구성을 외관만으로 확정하지 않음
excludes: 직조 조직은 texture도 가능; 화학 정체·온도·내구성을 외관만으로 확정하지 않음
includes: Declared surface material and observable optical response; chemical identity and performance require separate context.

surface_moisture.description: Explicit wetness, dampness, dryness or bounded moisture state of an identified physical surface, distinct from surface material, texture and optical sheen.
surface_moisture.description_ko: 소유자가 명시된 물리 표면의 젖음·축축함·건조함 또는 한정된 수분 상태. 재질 정체, 표면 조직, 광택과 구별한다.
excludes: Gloss, reflectivity, color, roughness or texture alone does not prove moisture; moisture alone does not require gloss.
Air humidity, haze and airborne droplets are not surface wetness without an explicit surface relation.
Do not infer rain, sweat-gland activity, immersion, chemical composition, illness, temperature or a wetting cause from wetness alone.
Do not infer garment transparency, cling, a body region, new anatomy or exposure from damp clothing.
Dry humor, dry color treatment and emotional descriptions do not establish physical dryness.
includes: Explicit wet rock, wet fur or a damp forest floor, with an actual surface carrier and scope.

Actual skin or garment moisture can also support an appropriate skin/garment state role when the complete source independently satisfies that role. Share the supported fact; do not create duplicate owners or effects to obtain another tag.
A dry-to-wet boundary preserves its stated spatial scope. Droplet shape, free-liquid geometry and a condensation process need their separately supported facts.
Choose effect, prerequisite or preservation directly from the whole source; the slot name does not supply the mode.

surface_pattern.description: Bounded visible motif geometry and its layout, adjacency or explicitly stated repetition on one declared non-anatomical surface or design field, independent of physical surface microstructure, material identity, local hue and whole-frame composition.
surface_pattern.description_ko: 선언된 비해부학적 표면·도안 영역 하나에 속한, 경계가 있는 시각 모티프의 형상·배치·인접 관계와 명시된 경우에만 반복. 물리적 미세조직·재질·국소 색상·사진 전체 구도와 구별하며, 반복 없는 한정된 모티프에도 해당한다.
excludes: Physical weave, knit loops, raised ribs, roughness or relief alone without a separately declared visual motif/layout; these belong to texture, with material identity and optical response assessed separately.
Uniform local hue, palette, brightness or bounded color placement alone without a motif; color remains separate and no fixed palette follows from a motif name.
Whole photographic frame arrangement, negative space, crop or subject placement; a depicted design field remains on its own owner rather than becoming the surrounding photograph layout.

Owned anatomy or markings on a body/skin/hair surface, including a depicted body when the clause actually describes its anatomy or marking; use the appropriate anatomical, body_marking or makeup/hair role. An animal-shaped artifact ornament is not a new animal.
Garment-specific seam, opening, fold, trim attachment or construction alone; an actual visual print is not automatically garment_detail, and a generic fabric owner is not automatically a garment.
Physical object part assembly, hinge, cavity or strap routing alone without a separately stated motif/design relation; object_structure remains distinct.
Image grain/compression/lens artifacts, illumination/shadow projections or optical interference alone; a receiving-surface pattern is not inferred solely from lighting or processing.
Literal readable text content, symbolic belief, cultural affiliation, biological species, provenance, fabrication process, hidden chemistry or historical identity inferred from a motif.
An unbounded style label, metadata keyword, old effect/property name, optional child or render guard cannot supply positive motif geometry, owner identity, repetition or additional actors.
includes: A figural or vegetal ornamental motif whose line/shape joins belong to the same declared artifact surface or design field; no repetition is required unless separately stated.
Hooked teardrop motifs explicitly repeating on one declared garment print; orthogonal equal-width bands forming small checks on one declared fabric surface.
Geometric interlace cells with explicitly consistent adjacency on one artifact-bound design; graphic motif contours explicitly continuing across neighboring repeated design-tile boundaries.

A separately evidenced visual motif may coexist with physical relief, weave or local color on the same owner, but each role requires its own positive property. A flat print can establish motif geometry without establishing physical relief or a printing process.

surreal_concept.description: Explicitly intended departure from ordinary reality through one identifiable scene rule.
surreal_concept.description_ko: 요청된 현실 규칙의 의도적 이탈: 단순 기묘한 장소와 불가능 법칙을 구별; requester가 선택한 범위에 한정
excludes: 단순 기묘한 장소와 불가능 법칙을 구별; requester가 선택한 범위에 한정
includes: Explicitly intended departure from ordinary reality through one identifiable scene rule.

surreal_physics_detail.description: Local observable consequence of a selected impossible rule, distinct from ordinary coherence checks.
surreal_physics_detail.description_ko: 비현실 규칙이 만드는 국소 결과와 연결: 정상 반사·초점 일치는 일반 정합성; 비현실 세부와 보편 검사 규칙을 구별
excludes: 정상 반사·초점 일치는 일반 정합성; 비현실 세부와 보편 검사 규칙을 구별
includes: Local observable consequence of a selected impossible rule, distinct from ordinary coherence checks.

texture.description: Physical surface organization, roughness and repeated structure, not image-plane grain, compression or air particles.
texture.description_ko: 물리 표면의 반복·거칠기·조직 구조: JPEG·렌즈 먼지·공중 먼지는 다른 역할; material identity·영상 입자와 분리
excludes: JPEG·렌즈 먼지·공중 먼지는 다른 역할; material identity·영상 입자와 분리
includes: Physical surface organization, roughness and repeated structure, not image-plane grain, compression or air particles.

thermal_state.description: Explicit physical temperature state or temperature change of an identified carrier, separate from illumination color temperature, emotional warmth and a sensory proxy.
thermal_state.description_ko: 소유자가 명시된 대상의 직접 선언된 물리 온도 상태 또는 온도 변화. 빛의 색온도, 정서적 온기, 열감을 연상시키는 단서와 구별한다.
excludes: Lighting warm/cool or Kelvin color temperature, emotional warmth/coldness, and skin warm-color cues alone.
Steam, a red appearance, gloss or a sensory proxy alone does not establish actual temperature or a heating cause.
Naming temperature as a measurement variable without a declared state, value or change does not supply a thermal-state fact.
Do not add heaters, flames, particles, melting, burns, chemical identity, a numeric value or a heat-transfer mechanism from a thermal state alone.
Cooling alone does not establish a phase change. Explicit melting/solidification or a selected transformation stage requires its own source-supported fact.
includes: An explicitly warm cup, hot metal or cold surface; its actual carrier must be identified.
